title: SSE output gaps: causal reconstruction and tenant fallback orchestrator
creator: Aisha Malik
description: Several enterprise customers reported sessions where hosted SSE streams returned truncated / gap-ridden transcripts after transient edge disconnects. Root cause appears to be a combination of (1) per-edge in-flight segment drop on proxy failover; (2) ambiguous final-token markers from some model variants; and (3) a race between the client reconnect handshake and server-side KV-cache replay which results in duplicated or missing chunks for longer-running streams. This ticket implements a two-part mitigation: a causal reconstruction module that can deterministically reassemble partial segments using sequence metadata and checksums, and a tenant fallback orchestrator that routes recovery attempts through progressively stronger fallbacks (local cache replay -> alternate region replica -> deterministic re-gen on lower-capacity host) to minimize user-visible regressions.
reproduction_steps: 1) Start a hosted SSE generation with long context (>2k tokens) and streaming enabled. 2) Simulate edge proxy restart / tcp connection tear (use test harness from infra/sse-failures). 3) Reconnect client immediately; observe missing midstream spans and duplicated final tokens in transcript viewer. 4) Verify that current server logs show mismatched sequence_ids and no checksum mismatch in the fragment store. 5) Re-run with KV-replay disabled to confirm the race window disappears.
observed_behavior: Partial transcripts with one or more midstream gaps, occasional duplicated terminal tokens, and inconsistent per-tenant session indexes in logs. Affected customers saw 3-6% of long-running streams hit this failure mode during recent latency surge on 2026-02-28.
expected_behavior: On reconnect the client should receive a continuous transcript identical to the pre-disconnect ordering (modulo in-flight generation beyond checkpoint). System should prefer transparent repair (reassembly using fragments + checksum) before falling back to re-gen flows. No duplicated final tokens should be returned.
telemetry_and_logs: Added dashboard: /dashboards/sse-gap-rate (new). Query: count(stream_errors) grouped by tenant, sequence_gap=true, by minute. Correlation with edge restarts: logs/edge-proxy/2026-02-28 shows surge at 03:15 UTC. New ephemeral logs include fragment_checksums and reconstructor_decision per session. Linked alert: ALERT-STREAM-GAP-ERATE-1.
mitigation: 1) Short term: enable server-side conservative reconnect window (250ms) to let in-flight fragment commits complete; deploy to hosted only. 2) Customer-facing mitigation: instruct affected tenants to enable 'strict-sst' flag to force local session-snapshots every 256 tokens. 3) Ops: add runbook entry to console incidents doc with rollback steps.
proposed_fix: A) Implement causal_reconstructor that consumes per-fragment sequence_id, fragment_length, and a 32-bit checksum to attempt deterministic merging of adjacent fragments. B) Introduce fallback_orchestrator that (1) attempts local KV-cache replay, (2) if mismatch, routes to regional replica with preserved KV context, (3) if still unresolved, schedules controlled re-gen on a low-cost host with customer-visible notice. C) Add idempotency markers to outgoing SSE events to let clients dedupe duplicated final tokens.
implementation_notes:
- Reconstructor lives in runtime/stream/reconstructor.go and will add a 10-15% CPU delta in worst-case merging paths (bench locally).
- Fallback orchestrator is policy-based and pluggable across Hosted/Dedicated/Private: Private customers will default to 'local only' mode unless tenant opts-in for cross-region fallback.
- Need to extend session metadata envelope with 64-bit session_epoch and fragment_checksum fields. Backwards-compatible: new fields optional; older runtime ignores them.
acceptance_criteria:
- Automated e2e test coverage that simulates edge restart and validates continuous transcript reassembly in 95% of cases.
- Integration test that proves idempotent marker prevents duplicate final tokens.
- Telemetry shows stream-gap-rate drops by >=80% in canary region for 48h.
- Confluence runbook updated and on-call trained.
- Customer A (Enterprise-acct-17) validated fix in staging and confirmed remediation.
qa_plan:

- Integration harness: sse-failure-sim with 1k randomized disconnects across lengths.
- Canary rollout to eu-west-1 hosted, 10% traffic, monitor /dashboards/sse-gap-rate and latency regressions for 72h.
- Post-canary smoke: run full tenant acceptance with Dedicated replica and Private config matrix.
rollout_plan:
1) Merge and feature-flag behind 'sse_reconstructor_v1'. 2) Canary to eu-west-1 hosted (10%). 3) Monitor 72h, address regressions. 4) Gradual ramp to 50% then full. 5) Backport policy to Dedicated control plane and provide config toggle for Private air-gapped installs.
- Emergency rollback: kill feature flag and revert orchestrator routing (instant).
